sourceRefs.locator: Inv. 56.460, Description and Matières et techniques: inscription, costume, loss on 5 November 1831, wax impression in Ms. 609 fol. 63v, its rediscovery in 1857 and production of the gilt electrotype.

p. 3, introduction: date of the burial, composition of the hoard, four illustrated pierced silver coins, examination after removal from the ground and the authors’ interpretation of the selection; Table II: mints and rulers, including Leo I at Constantinople and Julius Nepos at Ravenna.
pp. 383–384, “The Franks and northern Gaul”: grave across the river from the fortifications, dress fastener, military symbolism, arms, ring and three horse pits.
p. 39, introduction and fig. 1 with caption: discovery by A. Quinquin, recovery by the parish chaplain, cemetery and position of the horse pits in the Saint-Brice neighbourhood.

note.de: Die kleine schematische Fläche bezeichnet das Viertel am Fundort. Das Grabungsareal und der frühmittelalterliche Friedhof hatten andere Grenzen.
note.en: The small schematic area locates the neighbourhood around the find. The excavation trenches and the early medieval cemetery had different boundaries.

note.de: Der goldene Siegelring mit der Aufschrift CHILDERICI REGIS gehört zur Ausstattung der gewöhnlich auf etwa 481/482 datierten Bestattung.
note.en: The gold signet inscribed CHILDERICI REGIS formed part of the burial generally dated to about 481/482.
